data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (con su banda) y Maya (vecina de laboratorio).
data.script: Oliver: Band practice, take one! Drums, ready? … Maya: Too loud! My glasses are dancing on the table! … Oliver: Okay, okay. Volume down to five. Better? … Maya: Better. But now the singer is too quiet — I can't hear the words. … Oliver: Ingrid, one step closer to the microphone! … Maya: Now the guitar… the guitar is fine. The song is just too fast. … Oliver: Too fast? It's rock, Maya! … Maya: Then my experiment needs new rules: no science next to the music room on Thursdays!

data.text: Complaints game: Student A suggests something impossible ("Let's swim to Australia!"). Student B rejects it with too/enough ("It's too far! I'm not strong enough!"). Five rounds, then swap.

homework.prompt: Write 4 sentences about things you can't do yet, with too or enough: I'm not old enough to… The piano is too…
